11957.scope: SU5_color is an enlarged COLOR parent, not the conventional SM SU5 GUT. It is not an E6/string/W33 vacuum. Perturbative matching holds only where Higgs/mass thresholds exceed strong scales. Cubic pole matches11950 locally; coefficient phase and global modular law remain uncomputed.

11958.residual_group: U1Z broken to gauged Z12 by Phi+-12; subsequently low P,T condensates break the residual group

spectator_parity.C_and_barC: odd under an additional unbroken spectator Z2; all other fields even
spectator_parity.negative_control: Without the tag, Lambda27B bar27C+P27C bar27C induces27C=-Lambda27B/P, invalidating the all-positive-charge condensate assumption. With tag, every allowed spectator vertex is at least quadratic, so C=barC=0 has no tree source; perturbative superpotential nonrenormalization forbids loop-generated inverse-P light vertices. Nonperturbative effects/soft breaking remain separate gates.

singlet_stability.proof: Rank5 holomorphic constraint Jacobian gives only two complex gauge kernels; positive rank2 moment-map Gram lifts radial gauge partners. Two spectator superpotential masses pm P^10 are nonzero. Canonical-K SUSY Hessian is positive on all26 remaining real singlet directions, although some masses are parametrically tiny. Other E6 components are not included.

11958.all_order_holomorphic_bound: For analytic UV superpotential monomials on the stated condensate branch, with unbroken spectator parity and perturbative SUSY matching: upper-block rho exponent>=23/2; first complex m or mu corrections exponent>=12. This does not include nonperturbative or soft operators. Neutral high-scale factors are real at this home.
11958.colored_spectator_mass: P 27C bar27C; two full pairs carry total SU3 threshold index12, so their mass phase is arg(P^12), real in the PhiMinus-real gauge at the stated F-flat home

light_singlet_gate.proof: Neutral U fluctuation has real mass-squared2 Lambda^2[(12 PhiMinus/Lambda rho^11)^2+rho^24]; the smallest physical eigenvalue cannot exceed this Rayleigh value.
light_singlet_gate.meaning: Classical exact positivity does not justify generic TeV-soft stability. High-sector sequestering or a different stabilization mechanism must be computed before trusting the soft-floor envelope.

11958.positive_spectator_mass: PhiMinus P^10 spectator^2/Lambda^10 is allowed; spectator VEV0 and positive supplied real mass, not a full E6 stability proof
11958.kaehler_floor: K contains P^dag T Q Hd Dc/Lambda^3; assuming F_P~m_soft P gives DeltaY~(m_soft/Lambda) rho^(3/2), much less suppressed than holomorphic rho^(23/2)

fixed_modulus_multiplier_response.upper_block_leak: X T Q Hd Dc/Lambda^2 and Y T Q Hd Dc/Lambda^2 are allowed. With F0=m_soft rhoLambda, combined unit-coefficient envelope is 3/[4(1+rho)] times the Kahler floor.
fixed_modulus_multiplier_response.scope: Exact multiplier response at fixed moduli only. Light P/high moduli cannot be assumed fixed under generic soft terms.

11958.scope: A declared anomaly-free added-field model and selected F/D-flat branch, not original W33 field content or a stable full E6/SM vacuum. Upper-block per-operator envelope assumes unit Wilson coefficients; other soft/gluino/tadpole effects and actual scales remain open.
